ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

2. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

3. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

4. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 15

7. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 7

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

10. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 1, 6

11. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

12. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

13. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 12

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 170

16. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Final Answer: 144 m²
